hero.title: Your center, teachers, and students — one organized ledger
hero.subtitle: Edura runs attendance, subscriptions, payments, and messaging — from the center's front desk to the parent's phone — in one system built for the Egyptian market.
hero.note: Works on mobile and desktop right away — nothing to install.

center.name: The Center
center.b1: Front-desk check-in by student code or QR
center.b2: Cash and online in one auto-settling financial ledger
center.b3: Halls with prices and pricing methods you set yourself
center.b4: Staff with scoped permissions and an audit trail for every action

teacher.name: The Teacher
teacher.b1: Groups, schedules, materials, and grades in one place
teacher.b2: A second check-in at the classroom door, and assistants with their own accounts
teacher.b3: An earnings wallet that updates with every completed lesson
teacher.b4: Collaboration requests with centers on clear terms before you accept

parent.name: The Parent
parent.b1: Your children's attendance and grades in real time
parent.b2: Pay for your child's lessons straight from your own wallet
parent.b3: Read-only oversight of minors' conversations with adults
parent.b4: Instant notifications for absences and payments

student.name: The Student
student.b1: Your schedule, materials, and grades in one app
student.b2: Points and rewards for attendance and commitment
student.b3: A prepaid wallet for your lessons

how.title: Three steps and you're live
how.s1body: Center, teacher, parent, or student — each role gets a tailored experience from the first minute.
how.s2title: Set up your classes and prices
how.s2body: Groups, schedules, halls, and payment methods — all from one dashboard.
how.s3title: Watch attendance and money in real time
how.s3body: Every lesson settles automatically, every check-in is recorded, and each party sees only what's theirs.

money.title: A financial ledger that closes itself
money.b1: Every completed lesson settles automatically at the rates in force when the class was created
money.b2: A financial record that cannot be edited or deleted — every piaster leaves a trail
money.b3: Online payment via Paymob or cash at the counter — both land in the same ledger
money.b4: Prepaid wallets for students and parents

safety.eyebrow: Minor safety is not an add-on
safety.title: Built from day one to protect students
safety.b1: Any student not verifiably an adult is treated as a minor automatically
safety.b2: Messaging adults requires a guardian contact channel
safety.b3: Parents get read-only visibility into their child's conversations with adults — disclosed to both sides
safety.b4: Each center's data is isolated at the database level
